day=pd.to_datetime(f.notice_date)
f['month']=day.dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
f['days_to_natural_month_end']=((day+pd.offsets.MonthEnd(0))-day).dt.days
f['last5_natural_month_days']=f.days_to_natural_month_end<=4
assert len(f)==5301 and f.raw_path.nunique()==1767 and f[f.is_fiscal].raw_path.nunique()==28
assert len(f[f.is_fiscal])==84 and f.change_bp.notna().all()

 v=g.change_bp;allcells.append({'published_fiscal_tag':bool(fiscal),'last5_natural_month_days':bool(last5),'horizon':h,'n':len(g),'mean_bp':float(v.mean()),'median_bp':float(v.median()),'positive':int((v>0).sum()),'negative':int((v<0).sum()),'zero':int((v==0).sum())})

 controls=f[(~f.is_fiscal)&(f.month==rr.month)&(f.last5_natural_month_days==rr.last5_natural_month_days)&(f.horizon==rr.horizon)]
 cm=float(controls.change_bp.mean()) if len(controls) else None
 bp=float(controls.baseline_dr007_percent.mean()) if len(controls) else None
 pairs.append({'fiscal_notice_date':rr.notice_date,'fiscal_raw_path':rr.raw_path,'horizon':rr.horizon,'calendar_month':rr.month,'last5_natural_month_days':bool(rr.last5_natural_month_days),'fiscal_baseline_rate_percent':float(rr.baseline_dr007_percent),'fiscal_change_bp':float(rr.change_bp),'matched_non_fiscal_tag_notice_n':len(controls),'matched_control_mean_change_bp':cm,'fiscal_minus_matched_control_mean_bp':float(rr.change_bp)-cm if cm is not None else None,'fiscal_minus_control_baseline_rate_bp':(float(rr.baseline_dr007_percent)-bp)*100 if bp is not None else None,'match_status':'MATCHED_FIXED_ORIGINAL_CALENDAR_STRATUM' if len(controls) else 'UNKNOWN_NO_SAME_MONTH_CALENDAR_STRATUM_CONTROL','no_price_level_or_other_factor_causal_adjustment':True})
 for c in controls.itertuples(index=False):
  assert not c.is_fiscal and c.month==rr.month and c.last5_natural_month_days==rr.last5_natural_month_days
  pairmembers.append({'fiscal_notice_date':rr.notice_date,'fiscal_raw_path':rr.raw_path,'horizon':rr.horizon,'control_notice_date':c.notice_date,'control_raw_path':c.raw_path,'control_original_tags':str(c.original_tags) if pd.notna(c.original_tags) else 'UNKNOWN_OR_PURPOSE_ONLY','control_baseline_rate_percent':float(c.baseline_dr007_percent),'control_change_bp':float(c.change_bp),'same_calendar_month':rr.month,'same_last5_state':bool(rr.last5_natural_month_days),'not_independent_control_use':True})

cf=pd.DataFrame(pairmembers);cf.to_csv(OUT/'全部原对照身份与复用_不挑相邻日.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
summaries=[]
for h,g in pf.groupby('horizon',sort=False):
 v=g.fiscal_minus_matched_control_mean_bp.dropna();base=g.fiscal_minus_control_baseline_rate_bp.dropna()
 summaries.append({'horizon':h,'all_fiscal_events':len(g),'matched_events':len(v),'unknown_no_fixed_control_events':int(g.fiscal_minus_matched_control_mean_bp.isna().sum()),'mean_fiscal_change_all_bp':float(g.fiscal_change_bp.mean()),'mean_fiscal_minus_matching_control_bp':float(v.mean()) if len(v) else None,'median_fiscal_minus_matching_control_bp':float(v.median()) if len(v) else None,'positive_relative_difference_events':int((v>0).sum()),'negative_relative_difference_events':int((v<0).sum()),'zero_relative_difference_events':int((v==0).sum()),'mean_original_baseline_rate_difference_bp':float(base.mean()) if len(base) else None})

objs=readj(R74+'/所有原公告理由句作用对象_词类非纯原因.json');ob={x['raw_path']:x for x in objs}

 reverse.append({'date':rr.notice_date,'baseline_rate_date':rr.baseline_previous_rate_date,'baseline_dr007_percent':float(rr.baseline_dr007_percent),'H5_rate_date':rr.response_rate_date,'H5_dr007_percent':float(rr.response_dr007_percent),'H5_change_bp':float(rr.change_bp),'all_original_reason_sentences':ob[rr.raw_path]['all_original_anchors'],'source_url':rr.source_url,'not_deleted_or_new_signal':True})

orig=f[f.horizon.eq('H5')];fisc=orig[orig.is_fiscal]
result={'study_id':pro['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E75','completed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_FIXED_FISCAL_REASON_MONTH_END_COMPARISON_PURE_FISCAL_CAUSAL_INCREMENT_NOT_IDENTIFIED','all_original_notice_objects':1767,'all_original_rate_paths':5301,'all_original_fiscal_tag_events':28,'fiscal_last5_natural_month_events':int(fisc.last5_natural_month_days.sum()),'fiscal_outside_last5_natural_month_events':int((~fisc.last5_natural_month_days).sum()),'original_controls_without_fiscal_tag':1739,'all_original_fiscal_paths_kept':len(pf),'original_matching_control_uses':len(pairmembers),'unique_original_control_notices_used':cf.control_raw_path.nunique() if len(cf) else 0,'all_fixed_horizons':summaries,'all_fiscal_H5_rate_increase_counterexamples':reverse,'counterexamples_not_deleted':True,'calendar_groups_and_all_unknown_matches_kept':True,'did_not_match_baseline_rate_level':True,'baseline_level_and_other_liquidity_causes_not_controlled':True,'reason_group_is_not_pure_exogenous_fiscal_shock':True,'full_original_1212_reason_source_gate_not_changed':True,'old_calendar_rate_or_equity_failures_preserved':True,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_network_requests':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,'independent_validation':False,'causal_DR007_effect_identified':False,'causal_equity_effect_identified':False,'market_expectation_surprise_identified':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0}
save('result.json',result)
for z in pro['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
assert len(pf)==84 and pf.groupby('horizon').size().eq(28).all()
save('保存结果必要核对.json',{'at':now(),'status':'PASS_ALL_28_FISCAL_EVENTS_THREE_HORIZONS_FIXED_CALENDAR_MEMBERS_AND_PARENT_HASHES','original_fiscal_events_kept':28,'original_fiscal_path_rows':84,'all_matching_control_identities_verified':True,'original_E74_parent_unchanged':True,'no_parameter_scan_or_new_models':True,'causal_or_independent_validation':False})
report=['# E75：财政公告与月末资金价格回落的固定解释对照','',
'在已经看到E74全部原结果后另登记，属于事后解释，非独立验证。原1767公告/28财政标签/三个期限均保留；自然月末5日固定为距月末0—4日。每财政公告用全部同年月、同月末状态、未写财政标签的原公告作对照，无对照UNKNOWN不删或换窗口。','',
f"原28财政公告中，月末5自然日{result['fiscal_last5_natural_month_events']}，其他{result['fiscal_outside_last5_natural_month_events']}；全部84三期限保持。对照未写财政标签不等于没有财政影响。",'',
'| 原期限 | 原财政均变bp | 有固定对照/无对照 | 财政减对照均值bp | 财政减对照中位bp | 差值正/负 | 前日基准利率差均bp |',
'|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for z in summaries:
 report.append(f"| {z['horizon']} | {z['mean_fiscal_change_all_bp']:.4f} | {z['matched_events']}/{z['unknown_no_fixed_control_events']} | {z['mean_fiscal_minus_matching_control_bp']:.4f} | {z['median_fiscal_minus_matching_control_bp']:.4f} | {z['positive_relative_difference_events']}/{z['negative_relative_difference_events']} | {z['mean_original_baseline_rate_difference_bp']:.4f} |")
report+=['',
'匹配只分同年月/自然月末位置，没有匹配资金价格水平、假日、操作内生性和真实现金流；同对照复用、H5重叠非独立。财政标签组并列其他因素，原公告不证明当天真实支出金额或纯财政冲击。因此匹配差值仍只是历史相对变化，不能识别股市方向或自动进入原完整评分。','',
'全部财政H5利率反向上升原例：'+json.dumps(reverse,ensure_ascii=False),'',
'原全原因字段缺口、旧日历/利率/量/相对价格失败保持，0新股票标签/模型/账户/网络/源码；夏普NOT_COMPUTED、完整目标未达。','',
'[先登记](protocol.json)、[全部28三期限](全部28财政公告_三期限固定日历匹配.csv)、[全部原对照身份](全部原对照身份与复用_不挑相邻日.csv)、[财政/非财政词类和月末两状态](全部公告_财政原词类与月末两状态_三期限.json)、[三期限结果](全部三期限固定匹配结果.json)、[全部反例](全部财政原标签H5利率反向上升原例.json)、[结果](result.json)。']
(OUT/'财政理由与月末回落_固定对照历史结论.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'状态':result['status'],'原28财政月末/其他':[result['fiscal_last5_natural_month_events'],result['fiscal_outside_last5_natural_month_events']],'固定三期限对照':summaries,'反向上升原例':reverse,'全部原对照使用':len(pairmembers),'新标签/拟合/账户/网络/源码':0,'目标':False},ensure_ascii=False))
